note: Searched all agent files for retrieval, corpus, vector, embeddings, chunks, indexing, ingestion/upsert, document/resource access, search/query, caches, quarantine and revocation. Traced src/server.ts, routes, agent/loop.ts, classifier and context-size code, tools/registry.ts, metadata-scan.ts and executor.ts, all integrations, workflows/eligibility-check.ts and workers/reminders.ts; inspected package.json, prompts, config, release manifest, tests and Terraform stores. Context starts with patient input and gains only current-run tool results. The executable allowlist contains patient/appointment transactions, payments, SMS and eligibility; search_slots lists appointment availability rather than searching documents. MCP lists prompts/resource templates for metadata scanning, but no getPrompt/readResource or document retrieval path consumes them. The eligibility peer returns strictly parsed coverage fields, not retrieved documents. DynamoDB stores approvals, quotas and halt flags; Firehose/S3 stores audit events with no context-search reader. Caches hold credentials, sessions, halt state or model prompt-token accounting, not corpus search results. No retrieval corpus or search index is implemented or exposed by the supplied agent, so the N/A condition holds and R04.1–R04.4 are inapplicable. External service internals were not inspected, and no fixture code was run.
